_sobre: Molde gerado por geracao_netcdf.molde a partir de sgpldE13.b1.20230829.000000.cdf em 2026-11-09. 'Optional': true = não gravar; 'value': '__AUTO__' = o código preenche. Ajustado para o ATTO: raw_spectrum com as dimensões na ordem real dos dados (velocidade, tamanho), fall_velocity_calculated por classe de tamanho, área nominal 0.0054 m^2 (o arquivo da ARM diz 0.54 m^2, mas o próprio number_density_drops da ARM usa 54 cm^2) — ver geracao_netcdf/aparelhos/parsivel2/DOCUMENTACAO.md.
_revisar: global platform_id: 'ld' é o código da ARM para o Parsivel²; confirmar o nome no ATTO
global datastream 'attldCA.b1', site_id 'att' e facility_id 'CA': confirmar
variáveis lat/lon/alt: copiadas do RD-80 (mesmo sítio ATTO-Campina); confirmar a posição do Parsivel²
global doi e dod_version: TBD (não reaproveitar o DOI da ARM)
global Conventions 'ARM-1.2' e data_level 'b1': decidir com o grupo (o RD-80 usa 'CF-1.8, ARM-1.2')

variáveis do telegrama (weather_code, mor_visibility, snow_depth_intensity, laserband_amplitude, sensor_temperature, heating_current, sensor_voltage...): marcar 'Optional': true as que o logger do ATTO não grava

qc_precip_rate.long_name: Quality check results on field: Precipitation intensity
qc_precip_rate.description: This field contains bit packed integer values, where each bit represents a QC test on the data. Non-zero bits indicate the QC condition given in the description for those bits; a value of 0 (no bits set) indicates the data has not failed any QC tests.
qc_precip_rate.bit_2_description: Value is less than the valid_min.
qc_precip_rate.bit_3_description: Value is greater than the valid_max.

raw_fall_velocity.long_name: Fall velocity classes observed by Parsivel2

fall_velocity_calculated.comment: Terminal fall velocity (Lhermitte) of each SIZE class; used in number_density_drops.

raw_spectrum.comment: Counts per fall velocity class (first) and size class (second), as the instrument telegram orders them. ARM ld.b1 files store the same layout but declare the dimensions as (time, particle_size, raw_fall_velocity).

equivalent_radar_reflectivity.long_name: Radar reflectivity calculated by the ingest

intercept_parameter.long_name: Intercept parameter, assuming an ideal Marshall-Palmer type distribution

slope_parameter.long_name: Slope parameter, assuming an ideal Marshall-Palmer type distribution

median_volume_diameter.long_name: Median volume diameter, assuming an ideal Marshall-Palmer type distribution

liquid_water_distribution_mean.long_name: Liquid water distribution mean, assuming an ideal Marshall-Palmer type distribution

number_density_drops.long_name: Number density of drops of the diameter corresponding to a particular drop size class per unit volume
number_density_drops.comment: N(D_i) = sum_j counts[j, i] / (A dt v(D_i) dD_i), A = 0.0054 m^2 (nominal 54 cm^2), dt = 60 s, v = fall_velocity_calculated; reproduces ARM ld.b1 (ld-b1-2.0).
